Can you jet ski on Koh Samui? | Yes, from beach operators in Chaweng, Lamai and Maenam and on guided rides. We recommend guided options: 1-hour rides from Maenam from 3,500 THB per jet ski, or our Jet Ski Safari to Pig Island for 9,950 THB per jet ski.
Is jet skiing on Koh Samui safe and legal? | It is legal and reasonably safe with a guide and a life jacket. The main risks are collisions near swimmers and damage-claim disputes after beach rentals, so film the jet ski first, get terms in writing and never leave your passport as a deposit.
Which water sports trip from Samui has the best snorkelling? | The Koh Tao and Koh Nang Yuan day trip has the clearest water; Ang Thong is good from 16 December to October; and Koh Tan on the Pig Island tour is the easiest reef for beginners, running all year.
Can beginners kitesurf on Koh Samui? | Yes, from December to April at the shallow, reef-protected lagoon on the south-east coast at Ban Harn and Hua Thanon, where a school teaches IKO courses. Avoid learning on busy Chaweng or Bophut.
Where can I rent a paddleboard on Koh Samui? | SUP boards are mostly delivered to your hotel or beach by a rental service in Maret, and some beach hotels lend them. Paddle the calm north and north-east bays such as Choeng Mon and Maenam in the morning.
Is there parasailing in Chaweng or Lamai? | The parasailing we sell flies over Lamai Bay: 2,000 THB solo or 3,000 THB tandem for about 10 minutes, launched from the boat. From Chaweng, a one-way car to Lamai costs 500 THB on request.
When is the sea calm enough for water sports on Koh Samui? | February to April is calmest everywhere, and January to September is good on most mornings. From October to December the east coast is rough and red-flagged, while the south and west coasts stay calmer.
Should I worry about jellyfish when doing water sports on Samui? | Most jellyfish are harmless, but box jellyfish occur occasionally around Samui and Koh Phangan and can be dangerous. Wear a rash vest, and if someone is stung pour vinegar on the sting for at least 30 seconds and call 1669.
What water sports can children do on Koh Samui? | Snorkelling at Koh Tan with a life jacket, kayaking in a double with an adult from about 4–5, night squid fishing, and riding as a jet ski passenger from 8 on our safari. Discover scuba usually starts at 10.
Does travel insurance cover water sports in Thailand? | It depends on the policy. Jet skis, kitesurfing and parasailing are often excluded or need an add-on, scuba is usually limited by depth, and almost all policies refuse claims involving alcohol, so check before you book.
